scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Finite exhaustive selection-matrix reduction, exact integer Sylvester certificates, polynomial spectral identity, Perron eigenvector and strict averaging inequalities.
scientific_integrity.replay_scope: 46656 uncentered selections; 729 centered selections; 540 strict activity comparisons

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the unweighted triangular-prism graph with counting measure, graph-distance balls and real ell_2.
No sharp result is asserted for larger prisms, weighted measures, other exponents or variation seminorms.
An unindexed equivalent calculation remains a publication-priority risk; independent scientific validation is not performed.
title: A cubic sharp norm and two extremizer orbits for uncentered maximal averages on the triangular prism
